extraction.name: WikiText
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset for language modeling consisting of text extracted from Wikipedia Good and Featured articles, designed to allow for the capture and usage of longer term dependencies.
extraction.creator: Stephen Merity, Caiming Xiong, James Bradbury, Richard Socher
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Articles fitting the Good or Featured article criteria specified by editors on Wikipedia were selected. The text for each article was extracted using the Wikipedia API.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Sections primarily featuring lists were removed. Minor bugs like sort keys and Edit buttons were removed. Mathematical formulae and LATEX code were replaced with <formula> tokens. Normalization and tokenization were performed using the Moses tokenizer, augmented to further split numbers. Words with a count below 3 were discarded and mapped to the <unk> token.
